in_marathi.name: Mrityunjoy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mrityunjoy हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mrityunjoy is a Sanskrit name, derived from the words 'Mrityu' (Death) and 'Anjaya' (Conquered). The name symbolizes victory over death and is often attributed to the mythological character Yudhishthira in the Mahabharata.
